pages.title: Ten TFC bushes
pages.text: B handles ten TFC berry bushes: blackberry, blueberry, bunchberry, cloudberry, cranberry, elderberry, gooseberry, raspberry, snowberry and wintergreen.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.text: Breaking a mature TFC bush is intercepted; the bush is harvested and left in its picked state instead of being removed. Empty-hand right-click harvesting is also handled.

pages.title: Waste
pages.text: Each bush yields its own bush waste item. These ten waste items are distinct from the 102 crop/spice waste items.

pages.title: Bush waste
pages.text: Ten TFC bushes produce their own waste; the bush is left in its picked state.
